ASUS TUF Gaming VG259QM5A Specifications

The ASUS TUF Gaming VG259QM5A is a high-speed professional gaming monitor designed for competitive eSports. Featuring a "Fast IPS" panel, it delivers a native 240Hz refresh rate with superior color accuracy and wide viewing angles, ensuring that fast-moving visuals remain sharp and vivid.

Display Specifications

  • Panel Size: 24.5-inch

  • Panel Type: Fast IPS

  • Resolution: 1920 x 1080 (Full HD)

  • Refresh Rate: 240Hz

  • Response Time: 1ms (GtG)

  • Brightness: 400 nits (Peak)

  • Contrast Ratio: 1000:1

  • Color Gamut: 99% sRGB

  • HDR: HDR10 Support

Gaming & Motion Features

  • Variable Refresh Rate (VRR): Compatible with NVIDIA G-Sync and AMD FreeSync Premium for tear-free gaming.

  • ELMB SYNC: ASUS Extreme Low Motion Blur technology allows ELMB to work simultaneously with VRR to eliminate ghosting and tearing at high frame rates.

  • GameFast Input Technology: Minimizes input lag for faster motion delivery from the connected device to the monitor.

  • Shadow Boost: Clarifies dark areas of the game without overexposing the brighter regions, making it easier to spot hidden enemies.

  • GameVisual: Provides 7 preset display modes to optimize visuals for different types of content.
